simple.summary: כּוּן (Kûwn) means Kun , a place in Syria First listed occurrence: 1Chr 18 8.

definitions.full: H3560. Kun II. כּוּן proper name, of a location city of Hadarezer ( מִטִּבְחַת ) ה עָרֵי ׳וּמִכּוּן 1Chr 18:8 , ᵐ5 ἐκ τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν πολέ ( μ ) ων (= בֵּרֹתַי 2Sam 8:8 ); = modern Kuna , near Bereitan (between Laodicea and Heliopolis), according to Furrer ZPV viii, 34, see בֵּרוֺתָה above, and Thes.
